# Live-Stream Clips

Cut a long ecommerce livestream recording into a batch of 15–60 second 9:16 vertical clips: pick segments by timestamps you list, by keyword hits in an SRT transcript you supply, or by automatic proposals split at pauses when there is no transcript, then export each clip with a blurred-fill background for landscape sources, an optional burned title and subtitles, and loudness normalisation — with highlight signals and a rule that every clip must stand on its own with a hook in the first 3 seconds.
